thread:
DeployBot: Rolling out v5.4.0 canary -> 15% (us-west2, eu1). Post-deploy quickcheck started (verifier id vfy-4358889999).
Ada: Kicking off cold-host quickchecks + end-to-end userflow sims. I’ll post results here.
Sam: Quick metric grab: /generate p95(us-west2)=120ms (baseline 115ms). No 500s so far.
OpsBot: quickcheck batch-1 finished. eu1 cold hosts: 4 timeouts, 2 fallbacks to quant-lite, ids: t-891,t-892,t-893,t-894.
Mike: Any recent routing changes to eu1? Could be circuit to small-quant.
Sam: Checking edge logs. Looks like on host bootstrap we saw repeated KV misses and a retry loop for ~1.2s before fallback.
Jen: Stack snippets show `kv.get` latency spikes on uninitialized hosts. Suspect prefill not triggered on new pods.
Lina: Recommendation: pause further ramp, pin eu1 to v5.3.5 for stability, and increase quickcheck timeout to 5s for cold-host runs until warmup fix.
Ada: Agree with pause + pin. @Sam please pin eu1 via rollout API. Example: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood/rollouts/pin -d '{"region":"eu1","version":"v5.3.5"}'`
Sam: eu1 pinned -> v5.3.5 (rollout pin id: pin-4358). Traffic migrated back to stable.
OpsBot: re-run quickcheck batch-2 on eu1 after pin: 0 timeouts, p95=118ms. All checks green.
Mike: Filing ENG-4309 to add deterministic prefill on new hosts + jittered warmup. Assigning to jen/infra.
Jen: PR opened: r/infra#482. Will add a synthetic regression that spins up cold hosts in CI. ETA ~3h.
Ada: Leaving canary at 15% (except eu1 pinned). Will monitor metrics & traces for 30m. If stable, escalate to 30%.
Lina: Quick public note draft: "v5.4.0 canary: minor perf improvements; eu1 temporarily pinned to v5.3.5 due to transient KV warmup timeouts; fix in progress (ENG-4309)."
Sam: also adding a temporary observability dashboard panel for kv.prefill success rate.
OpsBot: verifier report: PASS with region pin action in eu1. Recommendation: continue staged rollout after 30m stable window.
Mike: Thanks — will coordinate release notes and change log update. :thumbsup:
